title: mango gaaboysoh abaaro
intro: dumaahi baaxol, mango rooci sooleh ken ayyuntih gaddalih fanat. namma adda ardi barkat keenih yemeete sittallakle liggidittet, namma adda gaaboyso too ken sorkocobaxak kibbimtam faxxiimak ten faatit luk. Usuk qawwalayla tekke wak keenik inkih tan bar inki bar beenih, ken gacsi ken roocih numma gino kinnim qaddoysen. Atu ta numih kinnaane qaddossam duuddaa kay aydaadi Yallih barkat aamine waytaamih maabitinah ayfaf yacee?
clues: Anu mango saamile roocih fanat suge inkih tan baaxol, mango maaqot barkat luk suge.
namma adda gaaboyso yoo fan temeete namma sanatih addat, uxih yi sorkoco baxi yi Rabbih faatit mali.
Anu kaxxa caxaaxuwih arac liyo, woo caxaaxuwi, zeytuunii kee caxaaxuwi coox leeh, Yallih qaynat kinni.
yi caxaaxuwi arac finqite wak, anu tet finqitteh addat sooleh gaba qaran fan fiddinowteh, inni sarrimaane abaaro.
Anu Yalli tannah tan qawwalayla baaham duudak sugem ganak suge, walaa anu inni caxxi gaba yiggileh.
Yi digaala dubuk yi caxaaxuwih bayti hinna, takkay immay qigdu cato sinnim tet finqitteh addat, faxe catotta seecam maduuda.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Leeda le rooci leeda magaalak yemeete gaddali
Suuratul kahfih addal galab kak xageh yan dacarsittoh xiina.
Qinab caxaaxuwi dacrise nabiyyi shuqayb waktik
identity.answer: Suurak 26hattoh addat yan caxaaxuwi le ikoytiinu.

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: Caxaaxuwi aracay, zeytuunii kee caxaaxuwi coox namma sanatih addat finqite
location.answer: Caxaaxuwi aracay, zeytuunii kee caxaaxuwi coox namma sanatih addat finqite

verse: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]." (26:42-44)
